title: 🍽️ Multiple Mesa Food & Hospitality Jobs With Solid Pay - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Mesa’s food scene is busy, and a lot of spots are hiring right now. If you like fast-paced work, free meals, and talking with people, these roles are worth a look.
Arby's Assistant General Manager Employer: KBP Brands (Arby’s) Location: Mesa, AZ Type: Full-time Pay: Not listed (includes quarterly bonus program) Step into restaurant leadership: you’ll run shifts, coach the team, manage costs, and keep guests happy. Comes with medical, dental, vision, PTO, paid training, and free shift meals , plus a clear path to General Manager.
Crew Member Employer: Chipotle Mexican Grill Location: Mesa, AZ Type: Full-time (part-time options mentioned) Pay: Competitive (exact rate not listed) Good fit if you want to grow from entry level to management. You’ll learn every station, work with fresh food, and enjoy tuition assistance, free meals, PTO, benefits, digital tips, and strong promotion paths .
(Note: Another listing for Chipotle Crew Member in Mesa is the same role, so it’s not repeated here.)
Nutrition Assistant Employer: Dignity Health – AZ General Hospital Mesa Location: Mesa, AZ Type: Contract Pay: $19.26/hour Great option if you want a steady healthcare setting instead of typical restaurant work. You’ll prep and serve food for patients and staff, follow food safety rules, and help with tasks like stocking, tray service, and dishwashing.
Line Cook Employer: Jake's Unlimited Location: Mesa, AZ Type: Full-time & Part-time Pay: $17–$20/hour DOE Hands-on line cook role in a busy entertainment venue, focused on made-to-order food (not buffet). Expect nights and weekends, a free meal every shift, some benefits, employee discounts, and a chance to help build a new kitchen operation.
